note: Re-run of the 2026-11-14 deployment after six item prices were corrected locally. Bronze is append-only, so every source file re-landed as corrections rather than duplicates: the landed_rows below are the rows whose payload actually changed, not the file sizes. This run also exposed a real defect -- see zatca_chain.defect_found.

zatca_chain.defect_found: The first run of this step on corrected data doubled slv.zatca_invoice_documents to 50,002 rows: zatca_land joined ctl.invoice_outbox to brz.zatca_invoices_raw on request_id, and Bronze held two versions of every request, so each outbox row fanned into two. dbt's source_unique test caught it (25,001 duplicate invoice_uuid) and refused to publish Gold. Fixed by reading Bronze through _latest(), as every other Bronze reader already did; pinned by test_a_corrected_zatca_resend_does_not_double_the_silver_documents, which was verified to fail without the fix. The seconds and counts above are the re-run with the fix applied.

dbt_build_WH_MIZAN.note: Full parity with the local DuckDB target for the first time; the 2026-11-14 run predated three models and stood at 65.

gold_checks_WH_MIZAN.queried_over: the WH_MIZAN SQL endpoint with the service principal, after the dbt build

brz.zatca_invoices_raw.note: Two versions of every request: the original and the price-corrected re-send. Bronze is append-only by design; Silver takes the latest.

known_platform_behaviour.lakehouse_sql_endpoint_lag: After the ZATCA step rewrote slv.zatca_invoice_documents, the first dbt build still failed on the pre-rewrite snapshot: the Lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint syncs asynchronously behind the Delta tables. The identical build a minute later passed 91/91. Worth knowing before trusting a dbt result taken immediately after a Spark write.

zatca_chain_predates_the_price_correctio.why: run_zatca skips every request_id already in ctl.invoice_outbox, so a signed invoice is never re-priced. The chain on Fabric still carries the prices it was signed with on 2026-11-14, and the Fabric figure is exactly the local total from before the 2026-11-16 BR-KSA-50 price correction. Making the two agree would mean re-signing a cleared tax document, which a ZATCA chain must not do.
zatca_chain_predates_the_price_correctio.gap_it_exposes: The correction moved Silver, Gold and the bank reconciliation, and left the tax ledger on the old amount with no credit note raised. See HONESTY.md row 29.
zatca_chain_predates_the_price_correctio.test: apps/command-center/src/command-center/shape.spec.ts compares the chain's full shape exactly and bounds only the money; the exact comparison resumes when the totals meet again.
